punchline: Brené Brown asked several hundred special forces soldiers for one act of courage that didn't need vulnerability, and nobody had one.
thirty_sec: In 2014 Brené Brown stood in front of several hundred special forces soldiers and asked a simple question: can you give me one example of courage that didn't require vulnerability? The room went silent. Then a young soldier said: No, ma'am. Three tours. I can't think of a single act of courage that doesn't require managing massive vulnerability. She says she has asked it a couple of hundred times since.
